title: 4.02 / Product Naming
slide_intent: Name related services consistently so customers can distinguish them without learning a new vocabulary in each placement.
strategic_value: The repeated Spectrum prefix can tie individual services and bundles to the parent identity.
demonstration: Five ruled rows pair service descriptions with the names Spectrum TV, Spectrum Internet, Spectrum Voice, Spectrum Triple Play and Spectrum Double Play.
practical_value: Apply a common naming structure and distinguish single services from bundles.

content_islands.name: Heading and naming guidance
content_islands.spec: Place the heading left with a short consistency note above the rows.

content_islands.name: Service-name mapping
content_islands.spec: Stack five rows with small service explanations at left and large quoted product names at right.

ingredient.name: Spectrum product names
ingredient.role: Identify the service while keeping its parent brand visible.
ingredient.application: Use the complete names shown, including the Spectrum prefix and approved bundle names.
ingredient.scope: Products and bundles documented in August 2017; this is an archival naming system.
